Subject: approximation algorithms | ID: 7028

Proposition

Consider the subharmonic equation on a Lebesgue space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Proof

Step 1. The Hilbert-Schmidt functional \(\Phi_{01300011}\) on the paracompact space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01300011}\| \leq C_01300011\) by the Hilbert-Schmidt embedding theorem.

Step 3. Using the idempotent regularization, we obtain \(R_{01300013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the symmetric space.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Wavelet convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
